notes: Issue #30, third package; same decisions as breaker and rate (see scm/docs/package-layout-migration-map.md). -api: CacheConfig schema/defaults/TOML parsing, CacheError, DTOs, Processor/Validator/HttpCache traits, and the new CacheFactory and CacheLayer contract traits. -std: the moka-backed HTTP cache with stale-while-revalidate (cached entries, TTL decision, request snapshot) and the reqwest-middleware glue behind StdCacheFactory; every concrete type is crate-private. api/cache, api/cached and api/processor held only placeholder type aliases and empty modules; they are dropped.
test_rules: (?s)    // Verify the layer satisfies reqwest_middleware::Middleware \(compile-time proof\)\s*fn assert_middleware<T: reqwest_middleware::Middleware>\(\) \{\}\s*assert_middleware::<[^;]*>\(\);\s*
